cities.name: Skopje
cities.tagline: Capital of statues, bazaars and late nights
cities.gettingThere: International airport (SKP) 20 km east; buses to every city from the main station.

cities.name: Ohrid
cities.tagline: UNESCO lake town — the country’s jewel
highlights: Church of St. John at Kaneo
cities.gettingThere: ~3 h by bus from Skopje; Ohrid airport (OHD) has seasonal flights.

cities.name: Bitola
cities.tagline: City of consuls, cafés and Heraclea
cities.gettingThere: ~2.5 h by bus or train from Skopje; 1 h from Ohrid.

cities.name: Prilep
cities.tagline: Tobacco town under King Marko’s towers
cities.gettingThere: ~2 h by bus from Skopje, 45 min from Bitola.

cities.name: Struga
cities.tagline: Where the Black Drin leaves Lake Ohrid

cities.name: Kratovo
cities.tagline: A medieval town inside a volcano

cities.name: Mavrovo
cities.tagline: Ski slopes, a sunken church and mountain villages
cities.gettingThere: ~2 h by bus or car from Skopje.

cities.name: Tikveš (Kavadarci & Negotino)
cities.gettingThere: ~1.5 h by car from Skopje; arrange a driver for tastings.

attractions.name: Alexander the Great Monument
attractions.description: Iconic 22-metre bronze statue and fountain in the middle of Macedonia Square.
attractions.howToGet: In the heart of Skopje. Walk from anywhere downtown or take any bus to the main square.

attractions.name: Matka Canyon
attractions.description: Emerald canyon with kayaking, boat rides to Vrelo Cave and medieval monasteries.
attractions.howToGet: Bus #60 from the city centre (45 min) or taxi (20 min, ~500 MKD). Last bus back around 8 PM.

attractions.name: Mount Vodno & Millennium Cross
attractions.description: 66-metre illuminated cross on Mount Vodno with sweeping views over the city.
attractions.howToGet: Bus #25 to Sredno Vodno, then the cable car (~200 MKD return). Or hike up in 2–3 hours.

attractions.name: Skopje Fortress (Kale)
attractions.description: 6th-century fortress walls overlooking the Vardar river and the Old Bazaar.
attractions.howToGet: 15-minute walk from Macedonia Square or the Old Bazaar. Open sunrise to sunset.

attractions.name: Old Bazaar (Stara Čaršija)
attractions.description: One of the largest Ottoman-era bazaars in the Balkans — mosques, hammams, tea and kebapi.
attractions.howToGet: 5-minute walk north from Macedonia Square across the Stone Bridge.

attractions.name: City Park (Gradski Park)
attractions.description: Large leafy park along the Vardar with cafés, playgrounds and sports fields.
attractions.howToGet: 10-minute walk from Macedonia Square, or buses #2, #22, #24.

attractions.name: Kozjak Lake
attractions.description: Hidden emerald reservoir that’s perfect for a swim and a picnic.
attractions.howToGet: Drive ~45 min towards Volkovo, then a steep 20-min hike. No public transport — GPS essential. Best April–October.

attractions.name: Markov Monastery
attractions.description: 14th-century monastery with remarkably well-preserved frescoes.
attractions.howToGet: In Markova Sušica village, ~20 min drive from Skopje. Car or taxi (~600 MKD one way).

attractions.name: St. Naum Monastery
attractions.description: 10th-century monastery on the lake shore with peacocks and crystal springs.
attractions.howToGet: 30 km south of Ohrid. Boat tour (~1500 MKD), local bus (~150 MKD, hourly in summer) or taxi (~1000 MKD).

attractions.name: Church of St. John at Kaneo
attractions.description: The most photographed church in the country, perched on a cliff above Lake Ohrid.
attractions.howToGet: 20-min scenic walk along the Ohrid boardwalk, or a 5-min taxi from the centre.

attractions.name: Samuel's Fortress
attractions.description: 10th-century fortress crowning Ohrid with panoramic lake views.
attractions.howToGet: Steep 15-min climb from the old town. Open 9 AM – 7 PM.

attractions.name: Bay of Bones Museum
attractions.description: Reconstructed prehistoric pile-dwelling village built over the water.
attractions.howToGet: 15-min drive south of Ohrid. Bus to Peštani, then a 10-min walk.

attractions.name: Galičica National Park
attractions.description: Mountain ridge between lakes Ohrid and Prespa — you can see both from the top.
attractions.howToGet: Best by car; main entrance ~20 min from Ohrid. Guided hikes available.

attractions.name: Heraclea Lyncestis
attractions.description: Ancient city founded by Philip II of Macedon, famous for its floor mosaics.
attractions.howToGet: 2 km south of Bitola centre. 30-min walk or ~150 MKD taxi.

attractions.name: Pelister National Park
attractions.description: The country’s oldest national park, home to the endemic Molika pine and glacial lakes.
attractions.howToGet: 15 km from Bitola. Drive or taxi (~500 MKD). Mountain huts available.

attractions.name: Širok Sokak
attractions.description: Bitola’s elegant pedestrian street of old consulates, cafés and people-watching.
attractions.howToGet: Main pedestrian street of Bitola; all city buses stop nearby.

attractions.name: Kokino Observatory
attractions.description: 3,800-year-old megalithic observatory — one of the oldest in the world.
attractions.howToGet: Near Staro Nagoričane, ~30 km from Kumanovo. Car needed; the last 5 km are rough.

attractions.name: Smolare Waterfall
attractions.description: The highest waterfall in the country, tumbling almost 40 metres.
attractions.howToGet: From Novo Selo follow signs to Smolare village (15 km), then a 30-min marked trail.

attractions.name: Kratovo Stone Bridges
attractions.description: Medieval town built inside an extinct volcano crater, laced with towers and bridges.
attractions.howToGet: Buses from Skopje (2 h) or Kumanovo (1 h). The town is walkable.

attractions.name: Painted Mosque (Šarena Džamija)
attractions.description: Unique 15th-century mosque covered inside and out in floral paintings.
attractions.howToGet: Tetovo centre by the river; any city bus stops within a 5-min walk.

attractions.name: Kamenjane Waterfalls
attractions.description: A chain of small waterfalls in the foothills of the Šar Mountains.
attractions.howToGet: From Tetovo drive towards Brezno (30 min), then follow trail signs. 4WD recommended.

attractions.name: Mavrovo National Park
attractions.description: Largest national park — ski slopes in winter and a half-submerged church by the lake.
attractions.howToGet: Regular buses from Skopje (2.5 h). The ski resort has accommodation.

attractions.name: St. Jovan Bigorski Monastery
attractions.description: Mountain monastery famous for its breathtaking wood-carved iconostasis.
attractions.howToGet: Between Debar and Gostivar. Car or organised tour; beautiful but winding road.

attractions.name: Stobi Archaeological Site
attractions.description: Ancient Roman city at a crossroads of civilisations, with a theatre and mosaics.
attractions.howToGet: On the Skopje–Gevgelija highway. Stop at Gradsko, then a 10-min taxi.

attractions.name: Tikveš Wine Region
attractions.description: The country’s premier wine region — cellar tours and tastings around Kavadarci.
attractions.howToGet: Centred on Kavadarci. Book winery tours ahead and arrange a driver.

attractions.name: Treskavec Monastery
attractions.description: Remote mountain-top monastery among granite boulders, with stunning views.
attractions.howToGet: Difficult access: 4WD from Prilep (1 h rough road) or a 3-hour hike. Guide recommended.

attractions.name: Markovi Kuli
attractions.description: Medieval fortress ruins scattered across surreal rock formations.
attractions.howToGet: 15-min drive north of Prilep, then a 30-min marked trail from the parking.

attractions.name: Stone Bridge
attractions.description: 15th-century Ottoman bridge over the Vardar — the symbol of Skopje, linking the square and the bazaar.
attractions.howToGet: Right off Macedonia Square; walk.

attractions.name: Memorial House of Mother Teresa
attractions.description: Museum and chapel on the site of the church where Mother Teresa, born in Skopje in 1910, was baptised.
attractions.howToGet: On Macedonia Street, 3 min walk from the main square.

attractions.name: Museum of the Macedonian Struggle
attractions.description: Guided walk through the fight for independence with wax figures and grand halls. Tours run in English.
attractions.howToGet: On the Vardar embankment next to the Stone Bridge.

attractions.name: Skopje Aqueduct
attractions.description: The only surviving aqueduct in the country — 55 stone arches in an open field north of the centre.
attractions.howToGet: Taxi ~10 min from the centre (~200 MKD), near the village of Vizbegovo.

attractions.name: St. Panteleimon, Gorno Nerezi
attractions.description: 12th-century church with frescoes that anticipated the Renaissance — and a terrace view over Skopje.
attractions.howToGet: Taxi up Vodno’s slopes (~15 min, ~300 MKD).

attractions.name: Ancient Theatre of Ohrid
attractions.description: Hellenistic theatre in the old town, still used for the Ohrid Summer Festival.
attractions.howToGet: 10-min uphill walk through the old town.

attractions.name: Plaošnik & St. Panteleimon
attractions.description: Rebuilt church of St. Clement’s monastery — birthplace of the Ohrid Literary School — with early Christian mosaics.
attractions.howToGet: Between Samuel’s Fortress and Kaneo; walk.

attractions.name: Golem Grad (Snake Island)
attractions.description: Uninhabited island on Lake Prespa with ruined churches, juniper forest and lots of (harmless) snakes.
attractions.howToGet: Boat from Konjsko or Stenje on Lake Prespa, May–October. ~1.5 h drive from Ohrid.

attractions.name: Vevčani Springs
attractions.description: Cool mountain springs above a quirky village that once declared itself a "republic". Famous January carnival.
attractions.howToGet: 15 km from Struga — minibus or taxi (~500 MKD).

attractions.name: Lake Dojran
attractions.description: Warm, shallow lake on the Greek border — the warmest swimming in the country and traditional reed fishing.
attractions.howToGet: ~2.5 h by car from Skopje; buses via Gevgelija.

attractions.name: Demir Kapija Gorge
attractions.description: The "Iron Gate" — a dramatic Vardar gorge with climbing routes, cycling and nearby wineries.
attractions.howToGet: 1 h by car from Skopje on the E-75; also on the Skopje–Gevgelija train line.

attractions.name: Kuklica Stone Dolls
attractions.description: Over 100 eroded rock pillars that legend says are a wedding party turned to stone.
attractions.howToGet: 10 km from Kratovo; car or taxi, short marked walk.

attractions.name: Lesnovo Monastery
attractions.description: 14th-century monastery in an extinct volcano with some of the finest Byzantine frescoes in the Balkans.
attractions.howToGet: Car from Kratovo or Probištip (~30 min).

attractions.name: Zrze Monastery
attractions.description: Cliff-top monastery overlooking the Pelagonia plain — worth it for the sunset alone.
attractions.howToGet: ~30 km from Prilep, last stretch on a steep road; car needed.

attractions.name: Popova Šapka
attractions.description: Šar Mountain ski resort in winter, wildflower meadows and ridge hikes in summer.
attractions.howToGet: ~30 min drive up from Tetovo (winding road).

attractions.name: Mount Korab
attractions.description: Highest peak in the country (2,764 m) on the Albanian border. A long but non-technical summer hike.
attractions.howToGet: From Mavrovo by 4×4 to the trailhead; go with a local guide or the annual group ascent.

attractions.name: Duf Waterfall
attractions.description: A 20-metre waterfall at the end of a shaded 20-minute forest trail in Mavrovo park.
attractions.howToGet: Trail starts in Rostuše, 15 min past Bigorski Monastery.

venues.name: Garson
venues.description: Trendy cocktail bar with a cosy vibe, DJ nights and karaoke every weekend.

venues.name: Kotur
venues.description: Stylish bar with a chic interior, great music and DJs every weekend.

venues.name: Kino Karposh
venues.description: Bar inside a retro cinema with events, drinks and DJs.

venues.name: Crash Bar
venues.description: Underground rock bar with a raw, loud, friendly vibe.

venues.name: Pogon
venues.description: Hipster hangout with occasional gigs and events.

venues.name: Mambo Gin & Tonic Bar
venues.description: Near the centre, with a long list of gins to try.

venues.name: Samo
venues.description: Board-game café — pick a game off the shelf and settle in.

venues.name: Badu
venues.description: Outdoor chill zone in the park with a great vibe and all kinds of drinks.

venues.name: Radio Bar
venues.description: Known for house-music nights and creative cocktails.

venues.name: BKW Bar
venues.description: Rustic-modern bar with live music and outdoor seating.

venues.name: The Dude Specialty Coffee
venues.description: Specialty roastery and café with exceptional single-origin beans.

venues.name: Sinatra Coffee
venues.description: Elegant coffee bar with premium espresso.

venues.name: Edge Coffee
venues.description: Modern coffee shop with innovative brewing and specialty drinks.

venues.name: Greenhill Coffee
venues.description: Sustainable roastery focused on quality and environmental responsibility.

venues.name: Rutina
venues.description: Trendy café in Leptokarija with great coffee and a relaxed atmosphere.

dishes.name: Pastrmajlija
dishes.description: Oval flatbread topped with cured, diced meat and often an egg, baked until crispy.

dishes.name: Tavče Gravče
dishes.description: The national dish: white beans baked in a clay pot with paprika and onion.

dishes.name: Ajvar
dishes.description: Roasted red-pepper relish made every autumn and served with bread or meat.

dishes.name: Simit Pogača
dishes.description: Round sesame bread — crunchy outside, soft inside.

dishes.name: Šarska Pleskavica
dishes.description: Grilled meat patty stuffed with cheese — spicy, juicy and filling.

dishes.name: Sarma
dishes.description: Cabbage or vine leaves rolled around minced meat and rice, slow-cooked.

dishes.name: Burek
dishes.description: Flaky pastry with meat, cheese or spinach — the classic breakfast, with yoghurt.

dishes.name: Mekica
dishes.description: Fried dough, fluffy and golden — eat it with cheese, jam or honey.

dishes.name: Kebapi
dishes.description: Small grilled minced-meat sausages served by the ten with bread, raw onion and a pepper.

dishes.name: Selsko Meso
dishes.description: "Village meat" — pork and mushrooms baked in a clay pot with cheese on top.

dishes.name: Turli Tava
dishes.description: Slow-baked casserole of meat, okra, aubergine, peppers and rice.

dishes.name: Polneti Piperki
dishes.description: Peppers stuffed with minced meat and rice, baked in tomato sauce.

dishes.name: Ohrid Trout
dishes.description: The lake’s famous endemic trout is protected — most restaurants serve farmed trout or other lake fish instead. Ask what you’re getting.

dishes.name: Šopska Salad
dishes.description: Tomato, cucumber, pepper and onion buried under grated white cheese. Ordered with everything.

dishes.name: Pindžur
dishes.description: Roasted pepper, tomato and garlic spread — ajvar’s chunkier, garlicky cousin.

dishes.name: Malidžano
dishes.description: Smoky roasted aubergine mashed with garlic, oil and sometimes walnuts or cheese.

dishes.name: Gjomleze
dishes.description: Struga speciality: thin layers of batter baked slowly under a lid of hot coals. Takes hours — order ahead.

dishes.name: Baklava
dishes.description: Layers of filo, walnuts and syrup — the Old Bazaar sweet shops are the place.
dishes.where: Slatkarnici (sweet shops) in the Old Bazaar

dishes.name: Tulumba
dishes.description: Fried ridged dough soaked in syrup; crunchy outside, soaked inside.

dishes.name: Boza
dishes.description: Thick, slightly fermented millet drink — sweet-sour and a traditional match for baklava.

dishes.name: Rakija
dishes.description: Fruit brandy (grape "lozova" is classic). Sipped, not shot — "Na zdravje!"

dishes.name: Vranec Wine
dishes.description: The country’s signature dark red grape, deep and fruity. Try it in the Tikveš region.

eateries.name: Teteks
eateries.description: Popular local spot for grilled meats, burgers and toasties.

eateries.name: Royal
eateries.description: Go-to Skopje fast food for burgers and wraps.

eateries.name: Munchies
eateries.description: Casual burgers, pizza and international comfort food.

eateries.name: Jojo's
eateries.description: Event food truck with great burgers and hot dogs.

eateries.name: Oljo's
eateries.description: Burger spot on the bohemian street of Debar Maalo.

eateries.name: Silbo
eateries.description: Bakery open until 2–3 AM. Order the Silbo gevrek.

eateries.name: Mekicite na Straža
eateries.description: Legendary roadside stop on the way to Ohrid for fresh mekici — mandatory.

eateries.name: Destan
eateries.description: Kebapi institution in the Old Bazaar — the menu is basically one thing, done right.

eateries.name: Pivnica An
eateries.description: Restaurant in the courtyard of Kapan An, a 15th-century caravanserai in the Old Bazaar.

eateries.name: Skopski Merak
eateries.description: Busy Debar Maalo kafana with live starogradska music in the evenings.

eateries.name: Antiko
eateries.description: Stone house restaurant in Ohrid’s old town serving traditional and lake dishes.

festivals.name: Strumica Carnival
festivals.text: Masked parades and all-night parties before Lent.

festivals.name: Vevčani Carnival
festivals.text: 1,400-year-old pagan-rooted masquerade in a mountain village.

festivals.name: Skopje Jazz Festival
festivals.text: Running since 1982, with big international names.

festivals.name: Ohrid Summer Festival
festivals.text: Classical music, theatre and opera in the ancient theatre.

festivals.name: Struga Poetry Evenings
festivals.text: Readings on the bridges over the Black Drin.

festivals.name: Galičnik Wedding
festivals.text: A traditional village wedding with costumes and folk dance.

festivals.name: Prilep Beer Fest
festivals.text: Free open-air concerts and local beer.

festivals.name: Tikveš Grape Harvest
festivals.text: Wine parade, tastings and grape treading.

festivals.name: Ohrid Swimming Marathon
festivals.text: 30 km across the lake from St. Naum to Ohrid.

transport.title: City buses (JSP)
transport.body: Skopje’s public bus network runs from early morning to around midnight. Buy a refillable Skopje Card at kiosks, or pay the driver (~35 MKD). The card gives discounted fares.

transport.title: Taxis
transport.body: Licensed taxis are cheap and metered: ~50–60 MKD start + ~40 MKD/km, so 5 km is a little over 200 MKD. Always make sure the meter is running.

transport.title: BinBin e-scooters
transport.body: Scan the QR code to unlock, ~9 MKD per minute, max 25 km/h. Stick to bike lanes and park responsibly.

transport.title: Intercity, trains & cars
transport.body: Comfortable coaches connect all major cities (Skopje–Ohrid ~3 h). Trains are limited but scenic. Car rental at the airport and in the centre costs about €20–40/day.
